sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: Contemporary circus company Gravity & Other Myths goes beyond jaw-dropping feats to weave a tale of impassioned dedication. Eight acrobats and one musician share a peek behind the curtain of one of Australia's most celebrated circuses.
body: In Ten Thousand Hours, contemporary circus company Gravity & Other Myths goes beyond jaw-dropping feats to weave a tale of impassioned dedication. Calling the show an "ode to the countless hours needed to achieve great things," eight acrobats and one musician share a peek behind the curtain: dazzling insight into the journey of dedication and persistence that has made Gravity & Other Myths one of Australia's best loved and most decorated contemporary circuses.
